subject.title: feat: add selectable outlined message layout

question: Should ClickClack permanently support outlined message chains as a second core Appearance layout?
rationale: The implementation follows the recently merged appearance architecture, but choosing to maintain another persistent presentation mode and its cross-product interaction matrix is a product-support decision rather than a correctness question.

options.title: Sponsor the core option
options.body: Accept the additional device-local Appearance mode, then require the accessibility repair and a clean rebase with refreshed browser proof.

options.title: Keep one canonical layout
options.body: Decline the additional preference and close the PR to avoid expanding the permanent UI settings and layout-support matrix.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core option
recommendation.body: Accept the additional device-local Appearance mode, then require the accessibility repair and a clean rebase with refreshed browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the currently assigned reviewer and therefore the strongest available owner for confirming or declining this product surface.
